subject: Runtime / Infra HC prioritization + proposed offer structure
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Runtime / Infra HC prioritization + proposed offer structure

Hi Laura / Dev,

Following up on last week's staffing review — I put together a short slate outlining the immediate runtime/infra slots we should approve for Q1 hiring. The ask is for three heads: 1x Senior Runtime Engineer (L5), 1x Infra SRE (L4), 1x Platform Engineer (L4). Rationale in the attached workbook (20270118-runtime-hc-slate.xlsx).

Key points:
- Priority: Senior Runtime (critical path for reducing tail latency) > Infra SRE (oncall/capacity) > Platform Engineer (automation and rollout).
- Proposed comp bands (US west): Senior L5 base range $205k-$235k, L4 base $150k-$175k. We are proposing offer ceilings at top of band + 5% for strategic hires (to avoid immediate counteroffers).
- Offer buffer: request approval for up to 12% signing package (equity + cash bonus mix) if recruiter flags competitive constraints for L5.

If we can get greenlight on headcount and the offer-ceiling policy, I'll ask Recruiting to send initial market-rate intel and begin targeted outreach.

Ask: Laura — can Finance sign off on the buffer policy and confirm run-rate impact? Marcus — can you confirm org mapping and 30/60/90 expectations we should publish in the posting? Dev — any technical must-haves to add to the job descriptions?

Thanks,
Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Head of Runtime Platforms
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Karen Mills <karen.mills@finance.example.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Runtime / Infra HC prioritization + proposed offer structure

Jordan — thanks for the clear slate and the workbook. Looping in Karen from Finance to validate the run-rate and the proposed signing buffer.

Quick notes:
- Headcount: we have budgeted 2 runtime infra slots in Q1 from the org plan; adding a third requires manager-level reallocation or exec approval. Please include cost offsets if you want it to be a straight add.
- Offer ceiling + 5%: OK as a guideline but Finance needs a ceiling on total OTE and a templated pre-approved equity grant for the 12% buffer to avoid ad-hoc approvals.
- Suggest we approve the Senior L5 slot now (mission critical), and hold the third for reprior after recruiter feedback.

Karen — can you confirm if we can pre-authorize a 12% package (split parameters) for priority technical hires in Platform/Runtime?

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karen Mills <karen.mills@finance.example.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Runtime / Infra HC prioritization + proposed offer structure

Hi team — ran high-level math on the proposed packages. A couple of notes: 

- We can pre-authorize a 12% sign-on envelope for up to two critical hires (exec-approved roles only). Any additional exceptions (>12% or more than two hires) will need Finance + CFO sign-off.
- For budgeting, assume on-target equity refresh at 10% diluted over 4 years (use the attached estimate model).
- If Jordan wants to proceed with the L5 as mission-critical, we should mark it as "approved for immediate offer" and publish the OTE cap for Recruiting to reference.

I'll attach a short memo and a run-rate impact table by EOY; will share by EOD.

-Karen

--
Karen Mills
Director, Finance (Contracted)
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Runtime / Infra HC prioritization + proposed offer structure

Thanks — I reviewed the job templates and added a short tech rubric in the attached doc (excerpt pasted below). Main asks for Senior Runtime L5:

- Experience shipping production transformer inference optimizations (attention kernel, KV/cache work).
- Strong C++/Rust background or equivalent performance systems experience.
- Proven track record reducing p99/p999 latency and diagnosing tail behaviors.

I agree with approving the Senior L5 immediately. Recommend we set the initial offer at the top of band + discretionary signing buffer up to 8% and reserve the 12% for hard counteroffers rather than baseline. That keeps run-rate exposure lower.

Best,
Dev

--
Dev Patel
Staff Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Runtime / Infra HC prioritization + proposed offer structure

Jordan — brief org mapping inline:

- Senior Runtime (L5) -> reports to Jordan, will own kernel selection and perf SLOs for hosted API. 30/60/90 attached in the workbook.
- Infra SRE (L4) -> scoped to Dedicated fleet, SLOs under Marcus.
- Platform Engineer (L4) -> shared ownership for deployment automation, sits in Platform team but dotted to Runtime for first 6 months.

Agree with Dev on conservative use of the 12% buffer. Recommend: initial offer = band-top + 5% (auto OK), escalate to 8% with manager sign-off, escalate to 12% with Laura + Finance approval. If the group approves, Marcus will publish org mappings and hiring manager notes to the JD folder.

-Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Director, Platform Engineering

Per your guidance we'll prepare an initial offer at band-top + 5% and hold the 12% in reserve.
